messages.content: From Tom: Mate, I've moved to Cardiff for a new job at a bookshop. Come and visit in spring! Output JSON with keys person, new_city, workplace, invite_season.
{"person": "Tom", "new_city": "Cardiff", "workplace": "bookshop", "invite_season": "spring"}
Trek update: Snow started falling at noon at Manali and the road to the pass is closed. Put that into JSON with place, weather, started, road_status.
{"place": "Manali", "weather": "snow", "started": "noon", "road_status": "closed"}
json with 3 synonyms for 'beautiful'
{"synonyms": ["lovely", "pretty", "attractive"]}
Which sea does the river Ganga flow into? Please answer in JSON with keys river and flows_into.
{"river": "Ganga", "flows_into": "Bay of Bengal"}
JSON: freezing point of water, keys freezing_point and unit
{"freezing_point": 0, "unit": "Celsius"}
Where do fish live and what do they use to breathe? JSON keys lives_in, breathes_with
{"lives_in": "water", "breathes_with": "gills"}
Give the plural of 'child' in JSON with keys singular and plural.
{"singular": "child", "plural": "children"}
is a bat a bird? answer in json with a yes/no key called is_bird and a short reason key
{"is_bird": false, "reason": "A bat is a mammal, not a bird."}
Name 3 types of trees in India in a JSON array.
["banyan", "neem", "mango"]
Suggest 3 snacks for a train journey, JSON array.
["biscuits", "bananas", "roasted peanuts"]
Make it JSON: 3 things you can make from milk.
["curd", "paneer", "butter"]
My cousin wrote this in a text. Is it correct? JSON with correct and fix: Their going to the market after lunch.
{"correct": false, "fix": "They're going to the market after lunch."}
Politeness check please, JSON with level and reason: "Dear Principal, I respectfully request leave for two days as my grandmother is unwell."
{"level": "very polite", "reason": "It uses a formal greeting and \"respectfully request\" with a clear reason."}

Could you label the feeling in this text and say why? Use JSON with the keys label and because.

Text: "Honestly the film was okay. Some parts were slow, some were funny."
{"label": "mixed", "because": "The writer found some parts slow and others funny."}
Put the following into one of three bins in JSON, keys paper, plastic, food_waste (arrays): newspaper, bottle, banana peel, carton, plastic bag, leftover rice.
{"paper": ["newspaper", "carton"], "plastic": ["bottle", "plastic bag"], "food_waste": ["banana peel", "leftover rice"]}
The bus leaves at 7:15 from the Shiv Nagar stop. I want JSON, keys vehicle, time, stop.
{"vehicle": "bus", "time": "7:15", "stop": "Shiv Nagar"}
Could you write the details of the tree as JSON? The banyan is a large tree, found across India, and its roots hang from the branches.
{"tree": "banyan", "size": "large", "found_in": "India", "feature": "roots hang from the branches"}
Convert to JSON: I felt shy at the party but I made one new friend, Rosa.
{"feeling": "shy", "event": "party", "new_friend": "Rosa"}
Who is the winner here? Put in JSON. Asha ran the race in 14 seconds, Dev took 16 seconds.
{"winner": "Asha", "winning_time_seconds": 14}
In JSON, give the main animal and the main object of the story The Thirsty Crow.
{"title": "The Thirsty Crow", "animal": "crow", "object": "pot of water"}
